notes: Cockpit profiles: save as many named cockpits as you like, restore any of them on any airframe, and pick the one put back on a cold and dark load.
Engine oil from Fenix no longer shows NO-GO at its normal level: TechLog takes 23 qt as full with a 10 qt dispatch minimum.
The installer's 'Start when a Fenix is loaded' box is unticked by default, with a note for slow loading.
The Fenix EFB options in Settings are marked Beta; putting the cockpit back as you left it no longer is.
